notes: Early season: ratings lean on last year. The model does not know about injuries, holdouts or scheme changes.
272 regular-season games a year means far fewer picks than college and wider error bars on every number here.
Totals are shown for context but rarely qualify. Without play-level data the pro totals model ran 1.4 points behind the book and lost money in backtest, so the bar for a totals pick is set very high.
